title: 🔒 Fix Mass Assignment Vulnerability in OrdemServico Creation
body:
🎯 **What:** Fixed a mass assignment vulnerability in the  method where the  entity was bound directly from the request payload.

⚠️ **Risk:** An attacker could craft a malicious POST request to populate restricted fields during creation, such as , , , , etc., bypassing expected workflows and business rules.

🛡️ **Solution:** Introduced  to strictly define the properties that can be set during creation. The controller action now accepts the DTO, maps its values safely to a new  entity, and ignores any unauthorized properties.
